Author: Real Nunu
Name: Nunu's Windbound Bard
Punchline: MIDI Editor, Bard Workbench, native ensembles, and concert capture.
Description: Windbound Bard MIDI suite with a piano roll, MIDI Workbench, native ensembles and MP4 concert capture. Hosted Band adds join-code sessions with Concert Director, remote instrument and ARM controls, and scheduled playback. Includes copyable relay diagnostics, Concert Director, opt-in party follow, and Shortcut Bars.
Changelog: Hosted Band adds Concert Director controls for MIDI and track sync, per-bard instruments, optional remote ARM, readiness, single-bard retry, scheduled Start and band Stop.
